name: toxrill, the corrosive
mana cost: {5}{B}{B}
types: legendary creature slug horror
power toughness: 7/7
activated[1]: {U}{B}, sacrifice a slug: draw a card.
triggered: at the beginning of each end step, put a slime counter on each creature you don't control.
triggered: whenever a creature you don't control with a slime counter on it dies, create a 1/1 black slug creature token.
static: creatures you don't control get -1/-1 for each slime counter on them.
